title: Unauthorized process or executable runs
bad_event: A program runs whose loaded content digest is not allowlisted, or an interpreter runs a script whose digest is not allowlisted (or with no script).
adversary: Model: any writes to writable paths and any exec with any script argument.
refutation: An exec of non-allowlisted content despite full checks (witnesses: path allowlist TOCTOU, writable exec mount, interpreter loophole, interpreter REPL).
scope: Lean model only. Not: memfd/JIT loaders, kernel exploits.

assumptions.text: Every exec (incl. loaders, memfd, JIT) is mediated by the digest policy.
The bytes hashed are the bytes loaded.
